hero.title: Infrastructure, software and automation. One accountable team.
hero.lead: You shouldn't have to coordinate three vendors to solve technology. One contract covers everything from the network to custom software.

after.title: With one team
after.caption: One contract covers all four fronts. One accountable person answers for the whole.

process.title: Four stages, deadlines up front
process.lead: You know what happens in each stage before you sign anything.

steps.name: Diagnosis
steps.text: We map your operation, your systems and where time gets lost. You get a report with priorities.

steps.name: Proposal
steps.text: Fixed scope: what is and is not included, timeline and price.

steps.name: Delivery
steps.text: Short deliveries, a demo at every milestone and visibility into progress.

steps.name: Ongoing support
steps.text: Monitoring, support and evolution, with an SLA defined in the contract.

items.a: It depends on scope. After the diagnosis you get a proposal with fixed scope, timeline and price — no open-ended estimates.
The diagnosis starts as soon as the first conversation confirms it makes sense for both sides. The delivery timeline is in the proposal.

items.q: What does the contract look like?
items.a: Projects are contracted by scope. Managed IT and squads are recurring contracts, with an SLA and written exit terms.

items.q: Who is my point of contact?
items.a: One person accountable for your contract, who knows the history and coordinates the specialties involved.
The SLA defines response times and what happens if they are missed. Every incident gets a report with cause and fix.
Exit terms are in the contract. Documentation, access and code stay with you.

contact.title: Tell us what is holding your operation back
contact.lead: We answer with a diagnosis, not a generic quote. The contact form arrives in the next version of the site.
